title: slugify returns the title unchanged instead of a URL-safe slug
goal: slugify(title) turns a title into a lower-case, dash-separated slug made only of a-z, 0-9 and dashes, so it can be put in a URL.

criteria.text: Slugifying a title gives a slug that can be put in a URL, so "Hello World" becomes "hello-world".
Upper-case letters are turned into lower case, so "Hello" becomes "hello".
A space between words becomes a dash, so "big world" becomes "big-world".
A run of several spaces becomes one dash, so "hello   big" becomes "hello-big".
Punctuation is dropped, so "hello, world!" becomes "hello-world".
Accented letters are dropped rather than converted to a plain letter, so "héllo" becomes "hllo".
Digits are kept, so "wrld 42" becomes "wrld-42".

title: parseDuration is an unimplemented stub that returns null for every input
goal: parseDuration(text) turns a duration string such as "1h30m" into a number of seconds, and returns null for text that is not a duration.

criteria.text: A duration with hours and minutes is returned as its total number of seconds, so parseDuration("1h30m") returns 5400.
A number followed by "s" is read as seconds, so parseDuration("45s") returns 45.
A number followed by "m" is read as minutes, so parseDuration("2m") returns 120.
A number followed by "h" is read as hours, so parseDuration("1h") returns 3600.
Hours, minutes and seconds can appear together and are added up, so parseDuration("1h30m15s") returns 5415.
Text that is not a duration returns null, so parseDuration("abc") returns null.
An empty string returns null, so parseDuration("") returns null.
A number with an unknown unit letter returns null, so parseDuration("1x") returns null.
Units out of largest-to-smallest order return null, so parseDuration("30m1h") returns null.
A unit that appears more than once returns null, so parseDuration("1h1h") returns null.
A number with no unit is read as seconds, so parseDuration("90") returns 90.
A space between the parts is allowed, so parseDuration("1h 30m") returns 5400.
Unit letters can be upper case, so parseDuration("1H30M") returns 5400.
A part can be a decimal number, so parseDuration("1.5h") returns 5400.
